manifest.description: Save and restore named workspace layouts, including panes, tabs, sidebar widths, Icon Rail, and Footer Rail. Plugin panels are remembered without restoring their internal content.
manifest.name: Workspace
plugin.workspace.setting.saveFooterRailD: New layouts save footer visibility and the left, right, and hidden item arrangement. Each layout can change this while saving or from its Includes menu.
plugin.workspace.setting.saveIconRail: Include Icon Rail in new layouts
plugin.workspace.setting.saveIconRailDes: New layouts save Icon Rail visibility, panel order, and hidden items. Each layout can change this while saving or from its Includes menu.
plugin.workspace.setting.saveRightSideba: Include right sidebar in new layouts
New layouts save the right sidebar’s visibility, width, panels, splits, and selected tab. Plugin content such as playlists remains independent.
